**What happens:** The Equipment menu slides open over the still-live Elite Monster fight; the player compares and swaps a hat and a top (each raising CP), then views (without swapping) the equipped cape; throughout this span the HP readout shows an anomalous "2704/5530" value that turns out to be a stale preview/UI artifact, and three more Elite Monsters spawn while browsing.

**On-screen text (verbatim):**
- [14:29] Partial equipment grid entries T4 Lv.34/T3 Lv.38/T2 Lv.38 etc., "Rare Hat", "Manage Equipment" heading fading in top-right, "Dismantle"/"Recommended Setting" controls appearing
- [14:30–14:36] "Manage Equipment" menu fully open, HAT comparison: left = character equipment-slot panel with a paper-doll avatar and locked accessory slots; middle = two side-by-side item-detail cards for "Red Misty" hats — T2 Lv.38 Rare Hat (Equipped: Attack 130 / Max HP 655 / Defense 81) vs. T1 Lv.38 Rare Hat (candidate: Attack 178(+48) / Max HP 897(+242) / Defense 86(+5), "CP Change +3,198"); right = the compact "Manage Equipment" 3-slot summary panel + Inventory "3/300" + "Auto Dismantle ON" + "Dismantle All". Auto-dismantle fires repeatedly ("Equipment has been dismantled automatically according to the set conditions."). Combat continues unattended behind the menu (damage numbers, EXP ticks 25.94%→25.964%). 14:32: player taps "Equip" — hat swaps to T1 Lv.38, dismantle message. 14:33: comparison panel reverses to show T1 (now equipped) vs T2 (now the "−3,198 CP" downgrade candidate), confirming the swap stuck
- [14:37–14:41] Comparison target switches to TOPS: "Black Royal Barone" T4 Lv.34 Epic Top (Equipped: Attack 204/Max HP 1,030/Defense 85) vs. T4 Lv.38 candidate (Attack 217(+13)/Max HP 1,153(+123)/Defense 97(+12), CP Change +971). "An Elite Monster has been summoned." banner re-appears at 14:37 (a second elite spawn while browsing the menu). 14:39: player equips the T4 Lv.38 top — comparison panel reverses (T4 Lv.38 now equipped, T4 Lv.34 now the −971 downgrade option)
- [14:42] Comparison panels close, no item selected — Manage Equipment shows plain 3-slot summary + stage info (Stage 5/10, Stage 6 Challenge) reappearing behind it. Loot toast "Liptask / Armor Stone x50" alongside "Equipment has been dismantled automatically..."
- [14:43–14:46] Comparison target switches to the CAPE slot: "Icarus Cape" T4 Lv.34 Epic Cape, Equipped (Attack 197/Max HP 1,022/Evasion 12), single-card view (no second/candidate card — this is the top tier already) with a teal "Enhance" button at the bottom (available, never tapped/no state change follows)
- [14:47–14:48] Still on the Icarus Cape view. "An Elite Monster has been summoned." banner appears again (third elite spawn this window)

**Counters & state:**
- [14:29] mp jumps to 605/634, hp=43068/45128, enemies flat 115/150, gold/gems flat 250,825/8,962.
- [14:30–14:32] CP chip reads 351,631 at 14:30–14:32 then jumps to 354,829 once the T1 hat is actually equipped (14:33 onward). HP is oddly low and PARTLY OBSCURED by the "Complete Now" button in every frame of this span — draft reads it as "2704/5530" consistently, which does not match the 31–45k HP scale seen in combat frames; very likely a preview/what-if Max-HP recompute triggered by the comparison UI, not the character's real live HP (UNREADABLE/likely-UI-artifact, flagged rather than trusted at face value). MP cycles 581→301/634 across the span.
- [14:37] Character/summoning-points chip drops 13/33→12/33 in the same frame as the second elite spawn.
- [14:39] CP chip updates 354,829→355,800 (+971, matching the shown CP Change). HP again reads the odd "2704/5530" placeholder throughout; MP cycles 356→605/634.
- [14:42] HP/MP finally show REAL, full-scale values again: HP=37286/45530 (Max HP rose from 45128 to 45530 from the top/hat CP gains), MP=568/634 — confirming the 2704/5530 seen at 14:30–14:41 was indeed a stale/preview artifact, not the live HP.
- [14:43–14:46] HP holds at 37286/45530, MP ticks down 537→431/634 from continued auto-combat, EXP creeps 25.99%→25.999%.
- [14:47–14:48] Character/summoning-points chip drops 12/33→11/33. HP dips 37286→36779/45530 (elite hit), MP 407→381/634.

**Timeline:**
- [14:29] Equipment menu begins sliding open over the live Elite Monster fight.
- [14:30–14:36] Hat comparison: T2 Lv.38 (equipped) vs. T1 Lv.38 (candidate, +3,198 CP); player equips T1 at 14:32; swap confirmed at 14:33.
- [14:37–14:41] Top comparison: T4 Lv.34 (equipped) vs. T4 Lv.38 (candidate, +971 CP); second Elite Monster spawns at 14:37; player equips the T4 Lv.38 top at 14:39.
- [14:42] Comparison panels close; real HP/MP scale confirmed (37286/45530).
- [14:43–14:46] Cape (Icarus Cape) viewed, single-card, top-tier already, Enhance button available but untapped.
- [14:47–14:48] Third Elite Monster spawns while still on the Cape view; player takes a hit.

**Flags:**
- [14:30–14:41] Draft reports HP as "2704/5530" as a plain COUNTERS value across this entire span with only a generic FLAG ("HP value partially obscured by Complete Now button"). Cross-checking against 14:42 (HP suddenly reads 37286/45530 — a completely different scale) shows 2704/5530 is almost certainly a stale preview/UI artifact tied to the equipment-comparison screen, not the character's real HP. Draft presents it as a normal reading rather than flagging the scale mismatch (see appendix).
